name: Splinter Hollow
description: Act 1, E11 The Walkout, and an Act 2 Kindred contact point. A sheltered basin inside a ring of hills with one way in from the east (`hollow-gate`): where Autonomists who walk out could found their own settlement (`splinter-camp`). Quiet: one spawn, outside the gate, and a long grace period. In the north a collapsed cellar under an old hull in our own build style (`old-cellar`) hints at the Survivors, the last of a purged Accord run. Suggested hooks: a walkout story that names this place, a later visit to the settlement, and the cellar as a deep secret.

sites.label: Collapsed cellar under an old hull (Survivors)
